reasons: New durable state transitions, database schema, public API and external subscriber boundary require architecture review.

subtasks.name: Domain contracts
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/domain -run 'Import boundary check rejects transport/SQL dependencies; sentinel domain errors cover every protocol mapping; injected clock provides deterministic UTC audit.'

subtasks.name: Reversible schema
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/infrastructure/postgres -run 'Up/down/up on disposable PostgreSQL validates audit columns, tenant-safe foreign keys, unique keys and due indexes; cleanup binds rows/transactions immediately.'

subtasks.name: Subscription persistence
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/infrastructure/postgres -run 'Create/list/delete under tenant isolation, bounded pagination and UTC actor audit; cross-tenant delete returns 404 and changes nothing; deleting leaves committed deliveries intact.'

subtasks.name: Atomic ingestion
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/infrastructure/postgres -run 'Rollback at each write boundary leaves zero partial rows; committed snapshot fanout survives process termination and restart; zero matches persist only the event.|Concurrent same-tenant retries return one event ID and one delivery per subscription; other tenant may reuse key; changed duplicate payload still returns original ID without fanout.'

subtasks.name: Trace logs and metrics
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/infrastructure/telemetry -run 'JSON logs contain trace/span context but no payloads, keys, secrets or credential URLs; metrics count request duration/errors, mutations and delivered/failed/deadletter using finite labels.'

subtasks.name: Safe outbound HTTP
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/infrastructure/delivery -run 'HTTP and SQL calls inherit deadlines and trace context; persisted trace parent links recovered work without detaching cancellation; reject unsafe resolved addresses and redirects.|Success and error responses close immediately; canceled requests terminate, no redirect follows, internal secret never propagates.'

subtasks.name: Gateway middleware
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/handler -run 'Valid secret and UUID admit typed tenant context; absent/wrong secret, missing/malformed/duplicate tenant or secret return 401 without repository calls; empty config rejects startup; optional actor fallback and spoofed body cannot override identity.'

subtasks.name: API and health
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/handler -run 'Live returns 200 regardless of DB; ready returns 200 for reachable DB and 503 within timeout when unavailable.|201 create, 200 replay/list, 204 delete; missing/inaccessible IDs 404, invalid JSON/URL 400, unavailable DB 503, sanitized unexpected 500; all sentinel branches asserted.'

subtasks.name: Bounded dispatcher
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/worker -run 'Concurrent ingestion/delivery never exceeds W workers; shutdown stops claims, cancels I/O and waits; expired claims recover and stale fencing updates cannot overwrite newer ownership.|Crash after receipt before acknowledgment produces retry with same delivery ID; different subscribers receive distinct IDs.'

subtasks.name: Crash recovery integration
subtasks.verification_command: NO_COLOR=1 go test -race -timeout 90s ./pkg/integration -run 'Child process commits then is forcibly killed before send or acknowledgment; restart against same DB drains eligible rows; barriers not sleeps control crash window.'
